visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Visitors walk along a paved path toward a large, unique building with a pyramid-like shape completely covered in vibrant green grass. The sky is bright blue with scattered white clouds. (2) Close-up of a worker's hands in blue gloves using a flat tool to smooth a layer of cream onto a large, rotating cylindrical cake (Baumkuchen) on an industrial machine. (3) Shots of the building's exterior show a wooden walkway underneath a thick overhang of grass and plants. People in casual summer clothing stroll through the facility. (4) An outdoor scene features a tall, vertical rock formation placed on a small mound of grass, with the modern, textured wooden building and hills in the distance. (5) Interior view of a retail space where numerous orange and brown round tins are neatly stacked on wooden shelves. A price tag and product description are visible. (6) A series of close-ups show various confections, including a checkered box containing a whole Baumkuchen and a plate with two sandwich-style cookies filled with red bean paste. (7) A person in a white shirt carries a black shopping basket through a store filled with tiered displays of packaged gifts. (8) In a cafe setting, a table holds a plate of dorayaki with cream and a glass of iced caffe latte. (9) Factory tour view: workers in full white sanitary suits and masks stand behind glass, monitoring a conveyor belt where rows of small, round ring cakes are being transported and packaged.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 什麼！這裡竟然是觀光工廠？. [Logo]: 日本失心瘋. (2) [Subtitle]: 建築物上都披上了一層植被. (3) [Subtitle]: 和大自然融為一體. (4) [Subtitle]: 這裡其實是甜點品牌「TANEYA」與「CLUB HARIE」的觀光園區. (5) [Subtitle]: CLUB HARIE 最有名的就是超好吃的年輪蛋糕. (6) [Subtitle]: TANEYA 招牌則是「夾餡天平」最中餅裡包著紅豆餡與求肥（糯米糕）. (7) [Subtitle]: 裡面不只買得到這些經典伴手禮. (8) [Subtitle]: 也有咖啡廳可以坐下休息好好享用甜點. (9) [Subtitle]: 甚至還有免費工廠見學!!!. (10) [Subtitle]: 看著製作過程覺得超級療癒啊~. (11) [Subtitle]: 我覺得這裡是滋賀必訪行程之一. (12) [Subtitle]: 計劃到滋賀旅遊的一定要到 La Collina 近江八幡 看看!. [Slogan]: ↓詳細資訊在內文↓.

It highlights the unique architecture integrated with nature, the specialized desserts from TANEYA and CLUB HARIE, and the engaging experience of the factory tour and cafe.
